Justice-impacted veterans & families

From confinement to community, from survival to purpose. The road from a cell to a stable life is easier with someone who understands both sides of it.

For veterans

  • Reflection: someone who listens without judgment and keeps what you share confidential
  • Healing and recovery: referrals to peer specialists and recovery programs
  • Reintegration: housing, work, benefits, and documentation lined up before release
  • Home base: a steady point of contact once you’re out

For families

  • Plain-language orientation to the resources available to your veteran
  • A point of contact who will return your message and follow through
  • Help finding support for spouses, parents, and children
  • Spanish-language assistance on request

This is peer outreach and resource navigation. It does not replace medical, mental-health, or legal care, and I will point you to qualified professionals when that’s what’s needed.
